whenToUse: Stores, pickup points and warehouses as a numbered list and map sharing one selection.
Operators closing a location for today or adding a new one.
avoidWhen: A single location's map and opening hours on a site — use map-hours.
Live dispatch of jobs and vehicles — use dashboard-16.
a11y: List rows handle keyboard selection; filters are aria-pressed toggles.
Never require the map — everything is reachable from the list.
